g.title: TF_AI_MODELS
g.text: Name of the deployment. This is the name that will be used when calling the service.
Name of the deployment when used in development.
This is the model the deployment descend from. For example, Chat GPT 3.5 Turbo.

Version of the deployed model. This might not reflect the real model version, for those deployed models with an Auto Update option selected. In such cases, on specific model versions retired, the Open AI service issuer might update the version automatically.
Max Input Tokens including System and User Prompt.
Max Tokens that the completion using this model can return to the user.
Rule that handles the Completion service call using this model.
This rules the accessibility to the use of this model at either run time or design time.
